newsitem.title: LATVIA: REPSHE SEES CPI PERMANENTLY BELOW 10 PCT SOON.
newsitem.headline: REPSHE SEES CPI PERMANENTLY BELOW 10 PCT SOON.

text.p: Latvian central bank chief Einar Repshe said on Wednesday that inflation permanently below 10 percent is a not too distant possibility.
"The fact that inflation has fallen below 10 percent is a symbolic signal that the long-avaited single-digit inflation is not too distant," Repshe told a news conference.
For the first time in post-war history, Latvian inflation fell below 10 percent level on an annual basis in February and was 9.9 percent.
"I do not know, whether we will be able to keep this figure throughout the year," he added.
